features:
⚠️NOTICE!!! PLEASE KINDLY HAVE TIME TO READ DESCRIPTIONS​ BEFORE USING⚠️

• This script is still in beta/testing or not yet verified and might not work on other devices/executor. ⚠️Please use at your own risk for potential bans/kick/crashing!​⚠️.

• This script is made specifically in Catalog Avatar Creator for its features to work. The Avatar Copier Feature might still work in other games/experience in some cases as it catch players Wearing Accessories/Clothing/Body that is available on the Roblox Marketplace, and then later Saves them. However❗, please remind yourself that executing this script in other games would pose possible incompatibility/interruption from others running script and can lead to ban/kick/crash❗. Please use with Caution and it is really adviced to use alt/smurfs accounts when running scripts/executor.

• Disclaimer❗: This script keeps players @Username and DisplayName(stored locally or IS NOT shared through link/upload/shared externally) for labeling and properly organizing Avatar properties purposes only(❗Do not try to do what sort of illegal/inappropriate things that would violate players account informations/reputation❗).

• Tested only on Delta Executor and Android Phone Device. Desktops might encounter issues.

• Credits: This script is inspired by a open source Catalog Avatar Creator script created by hi_hi_hi.

FEATURES:
- Free and no Key Systems
- Click and Hold to Copy(Any player on the map).
- Clipboard List of Saved Avatar(will Register any Avatar as long as its modified or even copied from the same player).
- Supports all accessory/clothings including custom heads, eyelashes, and makeups.
- Persistent Copied Avatars(Stays Saved even after rejoining, not until Cleared).
- Minimizable, Dragable, Destroyable UI/Instance.
- Save Current Wearing Outfit in One Click.

OTHER FEATURES:
- Duplicate Avatar Copy Prevention.
- Added UI Protection.
- Optimized Source Code.
- Prevent Issues Re-Executing the Script multiple times.

TIPS:
- Avoid being caught wearing others Avas(Go to map edge or jump high with low gravity or something, dont steal in front of their faces).
- Comment below if encounter any problem/issues/bug, Im eager to help(Will appreciate if you comment on details).
- Respect Everyone as always and Use this as a tool to explore Different avatars/accessories, not to violate.
- Since the Copier can sometimes work in other games, Copy a Avatar then later wear it on Catalog Avatar Creator. (This is not really recommended, Read the Notice above about this matter).
- Have fun Larping.
